main.description: Signs the caller in to the host's web pages, which they reached by signing in with atproto OAuth at their own PDS. The service-auth token the call carries says who they are; the answer sets an HttpOnly cookie that keeps them signed in to the pages for a day. The cookie stands for them only to the host's pages, never to their PDS.

handle.description: The handle the caller's DID document claims, when it resolves back to the DID.
